description: This file defines an interface EvictingQueue that extends Java's Queue, providing methods for adding elements with eviction of oldest elements when a capacity limit is reached. It is part of the monitoring logs system within a messaging connectivity service.

classes.name: EvictingQueue
classes.description: An interface representing a Queue with eviction behavior upon reaching maximum capacity.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Overrides Queue's add method to insert an element, evicting from head if full.

methods.name: offer
methods.description: Overrides Queue's offer method to insert an element, evicting from head if full.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Overrides Queue's addAll method to add multiple elements with eviction if capacity exceeded.
